intro: 耦合电感的每个线圈上，除了自感电压，还有另一个线圈电流产生的**互感电压**。整章的关键只有一句：**互感电压的正负由同名端决定**——先看清电流从哪一端流入、电压以哪一端为“+”，再写方程。理想变压器则是“只看变比 n”的极限模型。相量默认用有效值。

en.intro: Each coil of a pair of coupled inductors carries, besides its self-induced voltage, a **mutual voltage** produced by the other coil's current. The whole chapter rests on one rule: **the sign of the mutual voltage is set by the dots** — first see where each current enters and which end of each voltage is “+”, then write the equations. The ideal transformer is the limiting model described by its turns ratio n alone. Phasors are rms.

ideas.title: 互感 M 与耦合系数 k
text: 线圈 1 的电流 i_1 产生的磁通有一部分穿过线圈 2，在线圈 2 上感应出互感电压 M·di_1/dt；反过来也一样，两个方向的互感系数相等，都是 M（单位 H）。
耦合系数 k = M/√(L_{1}L_{2})，0 ≤ k ≤ 1。k = 1 称为**全耦合**（无漏磁）。k 只取决于两线圈的相对位置和磁路，题目给出 L_1、L_2、M 时可直接算出。

en.title: Mutual inductance M and the coupling coefficient k
text: Part of the flux produced by i_1 in coil 1 links coil 2 and induces a mutual voltage M·di_1/dt there; the reverse holds with the same mutual inductance M (in H).

The coupling coefficient is k = M/√(L_{1}L_{2}), 0 ≤ k ≤ 1. k = 1 is **perfect coupling** (no leakage flux). k depends only on the geometry and the magnetic path; given L_1, L_2 and M it follows directly.

ideas.title: 同名端与互感电压的方向
text: **同名端**（图中的“•”或“*”）的含义：电流从一个线圈的同名端流入并增大时，另一个线圈的同名端电位升高。所以：**互感电压的“+”在与“施感电流流入端”互为同名端的那一端**。
写线圈方程的标准做法：两个电流都取**从同名端流入**、两个电压都取**同名端为“+”**（各自关联），则 u_1 = L_1 di_1/dt + M di_2/dt，u_2 = M di_1/dt + L_2 di_2/dt；相量形式 U̇_1 = jωL_1İ_1 + jωMİ_2，U̇_2 = jωMİ_1 + jωL_2İ_2。任何一个参考方向与此不同，就把对应项改号。
线圈开路（i_2 = 0）时，它上面只有互感电压：u_2 = ±M di_1/dt。时域题中先求出 i_1(t)，再求导。

en.title: Dots and the direction of the mutual voltage
text: Meaning of the **dots** (“•” or “*”): when a current enters one coil at its dot and increases, the dotted end of the other coil rises in potential. So **the “+” of a mutual voltage is at the end that corresponds (by the dots) to where the inducing current enters**.

Standard way to write the coil equations: take both currents **entering at the dots** and both voltages **“+” at the dots** (each associated); then u_1 = L_1 di_1/dt + M di_2/dt, u_2 = M di_1/dt + L_2 di_2/dt, or with phasors U̇_1 = jωL_1İ_1 + jωMİ_2, U̇_2 = jωMİ_1 + jωL_2İ_2. Any reference direction drawn the other way flips the sign of its terms.
An open coil (i_2 = 0) carries only the mutual voltage: u_2 = ±M di_1/dt. In time-domain problems, find i_1(t) first and differentiate.

ideas.title: 串联：顺接与反接
text: 沿电流方向看，电流**都从同名端流入**（或都流出）是**顺接**，互感电压与自感电压同向，L_eq = L_1 + L_2 + 2M；电流一个从同名端流入、一个从同名端流出是**反接**，L_eq = L_1 + L_2 − 2M。
反接时单个线圈的电压 jω(L_1 − M)İ 可能是“容性”的（L_1 < M 时），但总电感 L_1 + L_2 − 2M 总 ≥ 0。顺接与反接测得的电感之差为 4M，可以用来测互感。

en.title: Series connection: aiding and opposing
text: Following the current, if it **enters both coils at their dots** (or leaves both), the connection is **series aiding**: mutual and self voltages add, L_eq = L_1 + L_2 + 2M. If it enters one dot and leaves the other, it is **series opposing**: L_eq = L_1 + L_2 − 2M.
When opposing, the voltage of one coil, jω(L_1 − M)İ, can even look capacitive (if L_1 < M), but the total L_1 + L_2 − 2M is always ≥ 0. Aiding minus opposing equals 4M, a way to measure M.

ideas.title: 并联与 T 形去耦等效
text: 两个耦合线圈有一个**公共结点**时，可以去掉耦合，换成三个无耦合的电感（T 形）：若两线圈在公共结点处是**同名端相连（同侧）**，两臂为 L_1 − M、L_2 − M，接公共结点的第三臂为 +M；若是**异名端相连（异侧）**，两臂为 L_1 + M、L_2 + M，第三臂为 −M。
第三臂 ±M 要串在原来接到公共结点的那部分电路上（例如公共结点经电容接地时，M 与电容串联）。注意判断“同侧/异侧”只看公共结点处接的是不是两个同名端（或两个非同名端）。
两线圈并联：同侧 L_eq = \frac{L_{1}L_{2} − M^{2}}{L_1 + L_2 − 2M}，异侧 L_eq = \frac{L_{1}L_{2} − M^{2}}{L_1 + L_2 + 2M}。也可以直接用去耦等效算。

en.title: Parallel connection and the T decoupling equivalent
text: When two coupled coils share a **common node**, the coupling can be removed and replaced by three uncoupled inductors (a T): if the coils meet at the common node with **like (dotted, or both undotted) ends**, the two arms are L_1 − M and L_2 − M and the third arm, at the common node, is +M; if they meet with **unlike ends**, the arms are L_1 + M and L_2 + M and the third arm is −M.

The third arm ±M goes in series with whatever was connected to the common node (e.g. if the node goes to ground through a capacitor, M is in series with that capacitor). To decide, look only at whether the two ends meeting at the common node are corresponding ends.
Two coils in parallel: like ends together, L_eq = \frac{L_{1}L_{2} − M^{2}}{L_1 + L_2 − 2M}; unlike ends, L_eq = \frac{L_{1}L_{2} − M^{2}}{L_1 + L_2 + 2M}. The decoupling equivalent gives the same.

ideas.title: 含耦合电感电路的正弦稳态分析
text: 最稳妥的是**网孔（回路）电流法**：先用支路电流写出每个线圈的电压（自感项 + 互感项，符号按同名端），再代入 KVL。互感电压由另一线圈的**支路电流**决定，一条支路被两个网孔共用时要用网孔电流之差。
结点电压法不能直接用，因为线圈的电流不能简单写成电压/阻抗（它还受另一线圈电流影响）；需要时先去耦，再用结点法。
验算：理想耦合电感不消耗有功功率，电源发出的有功等于所有电阻吸收的有功之和。

en.title: Sinusoidal steady-state analysis with coupled inductors
text: The safest method is **mesh (loop) analysis**: first write each coil's voltage in terms of branch currents (self term + mutual term, signs by the dots), then substitute into KVL. The mutual voltage depends on the other coil's **branch current**; a branch shared by two meshes carries the difference of the mesh currents.
Nodal analysis can't be used directly, because a coil current isn't simply voltage/impedance (it also depends on the other coil's current); decouple first if you want nodal analysis.
Check: ideal coupled inductors absorb no active power, so the active power delivered by the source equals the total absorbed by the resistors.

ideas.title: 空心变压器：反映阻抗
text: 原边回路阻抗 Z_11 = R_1 + jωL_1，副边回路阻抗 Z_22 = jωL_2 + Z_L。消去 İ_2 得**原边等效电路**：Z_in = Z_11 + \frac{(ωM)^{2}}{Z_22}，后一项叫**反映（引入）阻抗**。
反映阻抗的性质与 Z_22 相反：副边感性，反映过来是容性；它的电阻部分吸收的功率就是副边实际得到的功率。副边电流 I_2 = ωM·I_1/|Z_22|。
**副边等效电路**（求负载上的最大功率时用）：U̇_oc = \frac{jωM·U̇_s}{Z_11}（副边开路时的互感电压），Z_eq = jωL_2 + \frac{(ωM)^{2}}{Z_11}，再用共轭匹配。

en.title: Air-core transformer: reflected impedance
text: Primary loop impedance Z_11 = R_1 + jωL_1, secondary loop impedance Z_22 = jωL_2 + Z_L. Eliminating İ_2 gives the **primary equivalent circuit**: Z_in = Z_11 + \frac{(ωM)^{2}}{Z_22}; the second term is the **reflected impedance**.

The reflected impedance has the opposite character of Z_22: an inductive secondary reflects as capacitive; the power absorbed by its resistive part is exactly the power delivered to the secondary. The secondary current is I_2 = ωM·I_1/|Z_22|.

**Secondary equivalent circuit** (for maximum power in the load): U̇_oc = \frac{jωM·U̇_s}{Z_11} (the mutual voltage with the secondary open), Z_eq = jωL_2 + \frac{(ωM)^{2}}{Z_11}; then conjugate matching.

ideas.title: 理想变压器：变压、变流、变阻抗
text: 理想变压器（n:1）：全耦合、无损耗、L_1 → ∞。只用两个代数关系描述：u_1 = nu_2（同名端同为“+”），i_1 = −i_2/n（两电流都取流入同名端）；若副边电流取从同名端**流出**，则 i_1 = i_2/n。它既不储能也不耗能，任何时刻吸收的功率为零。
**阻抗变换**：副边接 Z_L，从原边看进去 Z_in = n²Z_L（与同名端无关）。电路中如果有元件跨接在原、副边之间，就不能直接折算，要把 u_1 = nu_2、i_1 = −i_2/n 当作两个额外方程，与 KCL/KVL（如结点电压法）联立。

en.title: Ideal transformer: voltage, current and impedance transformation
text: An ideal transformer (n:1) is perfectly coupled, lossless, with L_1 → ∞. Two algebraic relations describe it: u_1 = nu_2 (both “+” at the dots) and i_1 = −i_2/n (both currents entering the dots); if the secondary current is taken **leaving** its dot, i_1 = i_2/n. It neither stores nor dissipates energy: the power it absorbs is zero at every instant.

**Impedance transformation**: with Z_L on the secondary, the primary sees Z_in = n²Z_L (independent of the dots). If some element bridges primary and secondary, you can't refer it across; use u_1 = nu_2 and i_1 = −i_2/n as two extra equations together with KCL/KVL (e.g. nodal analysis).

ideas.title: 用理想变压器实现阻抗匹配
text: 负载 R_L 与信号源内阻 R_s 相差很大时，接入理想变压器使 n²R_L = R_s，即 n = \sqrt{R_s/R_L}，负载就能得到最大功率 P_{max} = \frac{U_s^{2}}{4R_s}。
求负载上的量时，先在原边等效电路中求 I_1、U_1，再按 U_2 = U_1/n、I_2 = nI_1 换算到副边。

en.title: Impedance matching with an ideal transformer
text: When the load R_L is very different from the source resistance R_s, an ideal transformer with n²R_L = R_s, i.e. n = \sqrt{R_s/R_L}, lets the load receive the maximum power P_{max} = \frac{U_s^{2}}{4R_s}.
To get load quantities, find I_1 and U_1 in the primary equivalent circuit, then convert: U_2 = U_1/n, I_2 = nI_1.

ideas.title: 全耦合变压器与理想变压器的区别
text: k = 1 的全耦合变压器满足 U̇_1/U̇_2 = n = \sqrt{L_1/L_2}，但 L_1 有限，所以原边电流 = **励磁电流** U̇_1/(jωL_1) + 折算的负载电流 İ_2/n。等效电路：理想变压器（变比 n）的原边并联一个电感 L_1。
L_1、L_2 → ∞（比值不变）时励磁电流趋于零，才成为理想变压器。

en.title: Perfectly coupled versus ideal transformer
text: A perfectly coupled transformer (k = 1) satisfies U̇_1/U̇_2 = n = \sqrt{L_1/L_2}, but L_1 is finite, so the primary current = **magnetising current** U̇_1/(jωL_1) + the referred load current İ_2/n. Equivalent circuit: an ideal transformer of ratio n with the inductance L_1 across its primary.
Only when L_1, L_2 → ∞ (at fixed ratio) does the magnetising current vanish and the transformer become ideal.

formulas.name: 耦合系数
formulas.when: 两线圈之间；k = 1 为全耦合。

en.name: Coupling coefficient
en.when: Between two coils; k = 1 is perfect coupling.

formulas.name: 耦合电感的 VCR（时域）
formulas.when: 各线圈 u、i 关联。两电流都从同名端流入时互感项取 +，一个从同名端流入、一个流出取 −。

en.name: VCR of coupled inductors (time domain)
en.when: u, i of each coil associated. Mutual terms + when both currents enter at the dots, − when one enters and the other leaves at its dot.

formulas.name: 耦合电感的 VCR（相量）
formulas.when: 正弦稳态，符号规则同上；ωM 称为互感抗。

en.name: VCR of coupled inductors (phasors)
en.when: Sinusoidal steady state, same sign rule; ωM is the mutual reactance.

formulas.name: 串联等效电感
formulas.when: 两线圈串联、流过同一电流；顺接：电流都从同名端流入；反接：一进一出。

en.name: Series equivalent inductance
en.when: Two coils in series carrying one current; aiding: the current enters both dots; opposing: enters one, leaves the other.

formulas.name: 并联等效电感
formulas.when: 两线圈并联：同侧（同名端接同一结点）取 −，异侧取 +。

en.name: Parallel equivalent inductance
en.when: Two coils in parallel: − when like ends share a node, + for unlike ends.

formulas.name: T 形去耦
formulas.expr: 同侧：L_1 − M，L_2 − M，公共支路 +M；异侧：L_1 + M，L_2 + M，公共支路 −M
formulas.when: 两线圈有一个公共结点；“同侧”指在公共结点处相接的是两个同名端（或两个非同名端）。公共支路接在新中心点与原公共结点之间。

en.name: T decoupling
en.expr: like ends: L_1 − M, L_2 − M, common arm +M; unlike ends: L_1 + M, L_2 + M, common arm −M
en.when: The coils share one node; “like ends” means the two ends meeting there are both dotted (or both undotted). The common arm sits between the new centre point and the original common node.

formulas.name: 原边等效电路（反映阻抗）
formulas.when: 空心变压器，原、副边无电的直接联系；Z_11 = R_1 + jωL_1，Z_22 = jωL_2 + Z_L。与同名端无关。

en.name: Primary equivalent (reflected impedance)
en.when: Air-core transformer, primary and secondary not otherwise connected; Z_11 = R_1 + jωL_1, Z_22 = jωL_2 + Z_L. Independent of the dots.

formulas.name: 副边戴维宁等效
formulas.when: 负载 Z_L 断开；U̇_oc 的“+”在副边同名端（U̇_s 驱动的电流从原边同名端流入时）。

en.name: Secondary Thévenin equivalent
en.when: Load Z_L removed; U̇_oc is “+” at the secondary dot (when the primary current driven by U̇_s enters the primary dot).

formulas.name: 理想变压器
formulas.when: n:1；u_1、u_2 都以同名端为“+”，i_1、i_2 都取流入同名端。参考方向改变时相应改号。

en.name: Ideal transformer
en.when: n:1; u_1, u_2 both “+” at the dots, i_1, i_2 both entering the dots. Flip signs for other reference directions.

formulas.name: 阻抗变换
formulas.when: 副边只接 Z_L、原副边之间没有跨接元件；与同名端无关。

en.name: Impedance transformation
en.when: Only Z_L on the secondary and nothing bridging primary and secondary; independent of the dots.

formulas.name: 变压器匹配
formulas.when: 电阻性信号源与电阻负载，用理想变压器使 n²R_L = R_s；U_s 为有效值。

en.name: Transformer matching
en.when: Resistive source and load, ideal transformer chosen so that n²R_L = R_s; U_s rms.

formulas.name: 全耦合变压器
formulas.when: k = 1；İ_2 取从副边同名端流出。L_1 → ∞ 时成为理想变压器。

en.name: Perfectly coupled transformer
en.when: k = 1; İ_2 taken leaving the secondary dot. Becomes ideal as L_1 → ∞.

examples.title: 空心变压器：用反映阻抗求原边电流和负载功率
examples.statement: U̇_s = 100∠0° V（有效值），ω = 100 rad/s，R_1 = 2 Ω，L_1 = 0.11 H，L_2 = 0.03 H，M = 0.05 H，副边负载 R_L = 4 Ω，同名端都在上端。求输入阻抗 Z_in、原边电流 İ_1、副边电流 I_2 和各部分的有功功率。
steps: 2. **反映阻抗。** Z_ref = (ωM)²/Z_22 = 25/(4 + j3) = 25(4 − j3)/25 = 4 − j3：副边是感性的，反映过来变成容性。

en.title: Air-core transformer: primary current and load power from the reflected impedance
en.statement: U̇_s = 100∠0° V (rms), ω = 100 rad/s, R_1 = 2 Ω, L_1 = 0.11 H, L_2 = 0.03 H, M = 0.05 H, secondary load R_L = 4 Ω, both dots at the top. Find the input impedance Z_in, the primary current İ_1, the secondary current I_2 and the active power in each part.
steps: 2. **Reflected impedance.** Z_ref = (ωM)²/Z_22 = 25/(4 + j3) = 25(4 − j3)/25 = 4 − j3: the secondary is inductive, its reflection capacitive.
5. **Secondary current.** From the secondary equation Z_22·İ_2 = jωM·İ_1, I_2 = ωM·I_1/|Z_22| = 5 × 10/5 = **10 A**.

6. **Powers.** P_RL = I_2²R_L = **400 W**, exactly the power absorbed by the reflected resistance, I_1² × 4 = 400 W; P_R1 = I_1²R_1 = **200 W**; the source delivers 100 × 10 × cos 53.13° = **600 W** = 200 + 400 ✓ (coupled inductors absorb no active power).

examples.title: 理想变压器把感性负载折算到原边
examples.statement: U̇_s = 100∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s，R_1 = 20 Ω，理想变压器 n = 2（n:1），副边负载为 R = 5 Ω 与 L = 7.5 mH 串联。求从 a 端看进去的输入阻抗、原边电流 İ_1、副边电流 I_2、负载电压 U_b 和负载功率。
steps: 2. **折算到原边。** Z_in = n²Z_L = 4(5 + j7.5) = 20 + j30 Ω：**电阻和电抗都乘 n²**，性质不变。
4. **副边电流、电压。** 按同名端，原边电流从同名端流入、副边电流从同名端流出，I_2 = nI_1 = **4 A**；U_b = I_2·|Z_L| = 4 × √(5² + 7.5²) ≈ **36.06 V**（也等于 U_1/n）。
5. **功率。** P_R = I_2²R = 4² × 5 = **80 W**，等于折算电阻吸收的 I_1² × 20 = 80 W；R_1 也吸收 80 W，电源发出 **160 W** ✓。理想变压器本身不吸收功率。

en.title: An ideal transformer referring an inductive load to the primary
en.statement: U̇_s = 100∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, R_1 = 20 Ω, ideal transformer n = 2 (n:1), secondary load R = 5 Ω in series with L = 7.5 mH. Find the input impedance seen at a, the primary current İ_1, the secondary current I_2, the load voltage U_b and the load power.
steps: 2. **Refer it to the primary.** Z_in = n²Z_L = 4(5 + j7.5) = 20 + j30 Ω: **resistance and reactance are both multiplied by n²**; the character does not change.

4. **Secondary current and voltage.** By the dots, the primary current enters its dot and the secondary current leaves its dot, I_2 = nI_1 = **4 A**; U_b = I_2·|Z_L| = 4 × √(5² + 7.5²) ≈ **36.06 V** (also U_1/n).

5. **Power.** P_R = I_2²R = 4² × 5 = **80 W**, equal to the referred resistance's I_1² × 20 = 80 W; R_1 also takes 80 W, and the source delivers **160 W** ✓. The ideal transformer itself absorbs nothing.

mistakes.text: 互感电压的正负凭感觉写。每一项都要问：施感电流从哪个线圈的哪一端流入？被感应线圈上与之对应的同名端是哪一端？该端就是互感电压的“+”。

en.text: Guessing the sign of a mutual voltage. For each term ask: where does the inducing current enter its coil? Which end of the other coil corresponds to it by the dots? That end is the “+” of the mutual voltage.

mistakes.text: 网孔法中互感电压用了网孔电流而不是该线圈所在支路的电流。公共支路上的线圈，电流是两个网孔电流之差。

en.text: Using a mesh current instead of the coil's branch current in a mutual term. A coil on a shared branch carries the difference of two mesh currents.

mistakes.text: T 形去耦时把同侧、异侧弄反，或忘了第三臂 ±M 要和原来接在公共结点上的元件串联。

en.text: Swapping the like-end and unlike-end cases of the T equivalent, or forgetting that the third arm ±M goes in series with whatever was attached to the common node.

mistakes.text: 反映阻抗写成 (ωM)²·Z_22 或 (ωM)²/Z_22* 。正确的是 (ωM)²/Z_22，性质与 Z_22 相反；它与同名端无关。

en.text: Writing the reflected impedance as (ωM)²·Z_22 or (ωM)²/Z_22*. It is (ωM)²/Z_22, of opposite character to Z_22, and independent of the dots.

mistakes.text: 理想变压器的电流关系弄反：电压高的一侧电流小，u_1 = nu_2 时 I_1 = I_2/n；阻抗折算到原边是乘 n²，不是除以 n²。

en.text: Inverting the current relation of an ideal transformer: the high-voltage side has the small current — with u_1 = nu_2, I_1 = I_2/n; an impedance referred to the primary is multiplied by n², not divided.

mistakes.text: 原、副边之间有跨接元件时仍用 n²Z_L 折算。这时必须把变压器的两个约束方程和结点方程联立。

en.text: Using n²Z_L when an element bridges the primary and secondary. Then the two transformer equations must be solved together with the node equations.
